PHYSICAL EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICAL EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Replace drinking water

2. Best practice when working on Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear.
   D. Damage equipment used for Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear.

3. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Volleyball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.
   C. Damage equipment used for Volleyball.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.

4. Best practice when working on Hiking Techniques ● Proper walking posture and pacing ● Uphill and downhill hiki: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Hiking Techniques ● Proper walking posture and pacing ● Uphill and downhill hiki.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Hiking Techniques ● Proper walking posture and pacing ● Uphill and downhill hiki.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Hiking Techniques ● Proper walking posture and pacing ● Uphill and downhill hiki.
   D. Practise Hiking Techniques ● Proper walking posture and pacing ● Uphill and downhill hiki with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the volume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the costume

6. Best practice when working on Javelin Throw ● Phases - Grip - Carriage - approach - cross over - release - fol: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Javelin Throw ● Phases - Grip - Carriage - approach - cross over - release - fol.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Javelin Throw ● Phases - Grip - Carriage - approach - cross over - release - fol.
   C. Practise Javelin Throw ● Phases - Grip - Carriage - approach - cross over - release - fol with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Javelin Throw ● Phases - Grip - Carriage - approach - cross over - release - fol.

7. Best practice when working on Steeplechase ● Techniques - starting - running between the barriers - clearing t: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Steeplechase ● Techniques - starting - running between the barriers - clearing t.
   B. Practise Steeplechase ● Techniques - starting - running between the barriers - clearing t with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Steeplechase ● Techniques - starting - running between the barriers - clearing t.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Steeplechase ● Techniques - starting - running between the barriers - clearing t.

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

9. Best practice when working on Discus Throw: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Discus Throw.
   B. Practise Discus Throw with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Discus Throw.
   D. Damage equipment used for Discus Throw.

10. Best practice when working on Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G.
   D. Practise Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. Best practice when working on Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas.

12. Best practice when working on Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Javelin Throw ● Phases - Grip - Carriage - approach - cross over - release - fol and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Discus Throw and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Shot put and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
